diagram_previews.alt: Part of a regular dodecagon: the isosceles trapezoid ABCD with the blue diagonal AD as its horizontal lower base and sides AB, BC, CD of length 4 above it, with one grey neighbouring side of the dodecagon going down from A and from D. Dashed perpendiculars from B and C meet AD at P and Q with right-angle marks; AP and QD are labelled 2 root 3, and a red arc marks the 30 degree angle at A.

difficulty_rationale: One accessible observation or a short chain of familiar deductions.
